name: War! Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The War! Heavyweight Championship changed hands on 12 June 2002 when Omega escaped a steel cage ahead of champion Richard Wyngarde to win the title, over interference from Morten Wyngarde at ringside.

name: Manhattan Championship
epitaph: The Manhattan Championship was created on 12 April 2002 and won by Saul Akiva, who beat Jason Charter in the inaugural final. Talon Vickers took the belt from an injured Akiva without a match on 6 May 2002; Akiva had regained it by 12 June 2002, when he beat Talon Vickers to retain it.

name: TV Championship
epitaph: The TV Championship was created on 12 April 2002 and won by Hammerstein, who outlasted eleven others in a battle royal to become the first champion.
